# #58814 [Bugfix][Kimi-K3] Refresh DSpark context KV cache pointers after the KV cache is re-bound

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58814 · okorzh-amd · MERGED · created 2026-09-26T02:12:19Z · merged 2026-09-28T16:05:11Z

##Purpose

Fixes a GPU memory fault and silent memory corruption in the Kimi-K3 DSpark draft, introduced by #57632.

```
21:05:36  JIT kernel warmup finished            (all 8 ranks)
          Warning: Queue error - HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT
          Memory access fault by GPU node-14 ... on address 0x7ec3c95b0000. Reason: Unknown.
21:15:38  [Rank 0..7] Watchdog caught collective operation timeout: _ALLGATHER_BASE ... 600000 ms
          RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed
```

K3DSparkModel caches the per-layer KV cache base pointers, and the block-layout flag, on first use and never rebuilds them. Since #57632 captures the context K/V precompute in the draft CUDA graph, that first use now happens during the CUDA graph memory-profiling capture. That capture runs against a temporary KV cache that is freed afterwards. The real KV cache is then allocated at different addresses, but the draft keeps the stale pointers, so every later context K/V insert writes into freed memory.

This change keys both cached values on the live kv_cache.data_ptr() tuple and rebuilds them when it changes. The pointer array is updated in place, so captured graphs keep reading live pointers. The rebuild only runs on eager calls; an assert guards against it running during capture.

kimi_k3/nvidia/dspark_mla.py is the only K3 DSpark implementation and is used on every platform, so this also applies to CUDA. It was only tested on ROCm.
